say: What if robots took every single job on Earth?
Right now, about three and a half billion people have a job.
show: Today, about 3.5 billion people have a job.

say: And about five million robots already work in factories.
show: 5 million robots already work in factories.

say: Now imagine they take over everything. A robot makes your coffee, drives your bus, and builds your house.
show: Now imagine robots take EVERY job.

say: Shops never close. Nobody ever calls in sick.
show: Shops never close. Nobody calls in sick.

say: But if nobody earns a paycheck, who buys the coffee?
show: No paycheck... so who buys the coffee?

say: Maybe everyone gets a share of what the robots make. Or maybe a few owners keep it all.
show: A share for everyone? Or do a few owners keep it?

say: Here's the twist. This has happened before. Six in ten jobs people do today did not exist in nineteen forty.
show: Twist: 6 in 10 of today's jobs did not exist in 1940.

say: Machines took the old jobs, and people invented new ones.
show: Machines took the old jobs. People invented new ones.

say: So, what would you do if you never had to work again?
show: What would YOU do if you never had to work? 👇
